newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Trend in NZ dwelling rise 1.1 pct in December.
newsitem.headline: Trend in NZ dwelling rise 1.1 pct in December.

text.p: Provisional authorisation statistics for new dwelling units for December 1996 show that the short-term trend estimate rose for the first time since April 1996, Statistics New Zealand said on Friday.
The trend estimate recorded a 1.1 percent increase from November to December.
An estimated 1689 new dwelling units were authorised for construction in December, 4.2 percent more on the same month last year.
In the December year, an estimated 22,682 new dwelling units were authorised, up 7.4 percent on 1995.
The largest increase came in Tauranga, Auckland city, Manukau and Whangarei.
The largest falls were in Palmerston North, Christchurch and Dunedin.
